SELECT AVG(freight_value) AS ortalama_kargo_ücreti
FROM order_items;

SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS ödeme_sayısı
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT payment_installments, AVG(payment_value) AS ortalama_tutar
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT s.seller_city, s.seller_state, COUNT(*) AS satici
FROM sellers s
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS satici_sayisi
FROM sellers
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT product_photos_qty, COUNT(*) AS sayi
FROM products
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
       AVG(r.review_score) AS ortalama_puan
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.review_id) >= 100
ORDER BY 2 ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) AS ortalama_gec_teslim_puani,
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) AS ortalama_zamaninda_teslim_puani,
    (AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) - 
     AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END)) AS fark
FROM orders
JOIN order_reviews ON orders.order_id = order_reviews.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered' 
  AND orders.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

SELECT s.seller_state, SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_item_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP'
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
       AVG(oi.freight_value) AS ortalama_kargo_ücreti
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
JOIN products p USING (product_id)
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t USING (product_category_name)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS siparis_ayi, 
  COUNT(*) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM orders
WHERE 
  order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' 
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
  AND order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-10-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01';

SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS gun, COUNT(*) AS siparis
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT seller_id, AVG(order_delivered_carrier_date - order_purchase_timestamp) AS ortalama_kargo_suresi
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
AND order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
AND order_id IN (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
)
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY ortalama_kargo_suresi DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('year', order_purchase_timestamp) AS yil,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS ortalama_sepet
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS musteri
FROM customers
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS siparis
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' 
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01';

SELECT AVG(ortalama_sepet) AS ortalama_sepet
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS ortalama_sepet
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.order_id
) AS subquery;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers
WHERE customer_unique_id IN (
  SELECT customer_unique_id
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 2
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers
WHERE customer_unique_id IN (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
      AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
)
AND customer_unique_id NOT IN (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
);

SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS kalem_sayisi
FROM order_items
GROUP BY order_id
ORDER BY kalem_sayisi;

SELECT 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN oi.price > (SELECT AVG(oi2.price) FROM order_items oi2 JOIN orders o2 USING (order_id) WHERE o2.order_status = 'delivered') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yuzde
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS ay,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS siparis_sayisi,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) / LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS degisim_yuzde
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
